name: Aarav Sharma
subject: Rotational Mechanics Doubt 1791840291480
message: How is moment of inertia calculated for a hollow cylinder versus solid cylinder?
reply: For a solid cylinder I = 1/2 M R^2, whereas for a thin hollow cylinder I = M R^2 because all mass is distributed at radius R.
